title: synthetic-data-evaluation
summary: An information-theoretic evaluation toolkit that compares ground-truth, simulated, and synthetic tabular and time-series data using fidelity metrics like Jensen-Shannon divergence, MMD, and classifier two-sample tests. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata/Metadata) to generate the synthetic-data arm of its GT-vs-SIM-vs-SYN experiment pipelines.
